items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Well, there was Bill Dogett on piano, Trevor Bacon was playing guitar, and vocalist... And then myself on drums.

ctx.x: And after I left there, Trevor Bacon was at the show; he caught the show, and he came backstage, and he wanted to know how long was I going to be staying with Roy Eldridge, and I asked him why, and he said that Lucky was looking for a drummer.

Well, I had heard so much about Lucky Millinder and his Blue Rhythm Ribbon Band, so I was real thrilled about him asking me this. Well, I didn't know what was gonna happen with Roy, so I told him, that "Well, I don't know what we're gonna be doing." So he said, "Look, we're rehearsing at the Sunset Ballroom", which was up on 125th Street between 8th Avenue and St. Nicholas, and so I went up there and I made a rehearsal with Lucky.
